title: Fix types  in `runner.py` file and creating `py.typed` file

raw.title: Fix types  in `runner.py` file and creating `py.typed` file
raw.body: Issue #100 In this PR, I’ve fixed the type annotations in the `runner.py` file, updated the code accordingly, and added a new `py.typed` file to indicate that this package includes type hints. I’ve verified the changes by running `mypy` locally to ensure all type checks pass.
